title: IDEX Health & Science and IDEX China Continue Collaboration with Fudan University
summary: Our Business Development Manager for IDEX China partners with Fudan University to help lead a program about life science optics.
body_markdown:
IDEX Health & Science has partnered with[Fudan University](https://www.fudan.edu.cn/en/) in Shanghai, China for the last 13 years for their FIST (Fudan Intensive Summer Teaching) program, which introduces college students to optics and their role in the life sciences. The course topic, entitled: “Application of Modern Microscopic Imaging Technology in the Research of Cell Biology,” has benefitted more than 600 students.


Helen Xu, Human Resources Director of IDEX China, spoke about the IDEX’s partnership with the University saying: “Life Science Optics is an important part of IDEX Health & Science, and this course is one of many activities that IDEX China supports to give back to the community.” It’s also an example of IDEX’s school-enterprise collaboration initiative.


Read on for some course highlights from the last few years:


In 2026, the School of Life Sciences at Fudan University celebrated its 100th anniversary. As part of this milestone year, more than 20 undergraduate students participated in the Fudan Intensive Summer Teaching (FIST) program, taking part in a hands-on course covering fluorescent protein theory, fluorescence imaging fundamentals, and the role of Semrock's Avant™ filter sets in advanced imaging applications.


Led by Wang Qi, Business Development Manager for the Semrock Optical Filters product line, the course also included practical training on the proper handling, cleaning, and assembly of optical filter sets into microscopy filter cubes as well as Semrock BSM and FH1 holders. The 2026 session marked Wang Qi's 15th year participating in the FIST program, helping generations of Fudan students gain exposure to the optical technologies that enable modern fluorescence imaging.


Prof. Cai Liang, organizer and instructor of the course, noted:


> "Semrock optical filters have been used in my lab for more than 15 years. Their performance has remained remarkably consistent with no noticeable degradation over time. The reliability and durability are truly exceptional."


On August 26, 2025, we powered through with our 14th FIST Program!


Wang Qi, Business Development Manager for the Semrock Optical Filters product line, led an engaging session that truly shone a light on the field of optics. He didn't just introduce the students to optical filters; he gave them a deep dive into the core principles, complex manufacturing processes, and the vital role these filters play in cutting-edge life science applications like advanced microscopy.


But the learning didn't stop at theory. Wang Qi also used[videos](https://www.idex-hs.com/resources/videos) from our[resource library](https://www.idex-hs.com/resources) to provide hands-on training on the essential skills of cleaning and correctly assembling optical filters into a cube. We were thrilled to host 40 enthusiastic college students from the School of Life Science, Fudan University, making our latest installment a huge success.


Returning for our 13th FIST Program, Wang Qi (Business Development Manager for the Semrock Optical Filters product line) introduced students to the principles behind optical filters, manufacturing, and explained the uses of filters in life science applications, such as PCR and NGS. He also used our[video material](https://www.idex-hs.com/resources/videos) to train attendees on how to identify the coating side, clean, assemble, and visually detect scratches and pockmarks.


In late August of 2023, Wang Qi returned to teach at Fudan University to 40 post-graduate students.


The most popular section of this year’s course was the practice and exploration segment, which Wang expanded and optimized so that each student could deepen their knowledge while receiving hands-on experience disassembling, assembling, and cleaning filters. He also guided them through any challenges they faced during the exercises.


Wang said, "I am glad to attend this course and help IDEX Health & Science to give back to local community."


For the past two years, the FIST course was held exclusively online due to the COVID-19 pandemic. 2022’s return to in-person classes was completed by 50 eager students who were excited to get hands-on experience.


Wang introduced the principles behind the filter, manufacturing, and explained the uses of filters in life science applications. He also explained how to clean, assemble, and visually detect scratches and pockmarks.


Thank you to Wang Qi and IDEX China for their commitment to helping others learn!


Due to COVID-19, 2019’s course on the Application of Modern Microscopic Imaging Technology in Cell Biology Research needed to be moved to an online format with Wang Qi and IDEX China’s help.


“We set up a live broadcast room in an IDEX facility meeting room, upgraded the network, and made arrangements for live broadcast equipment such as lighting that the university did not have. We did several rehearsals before bringing dozens of students a wonderful live online class,” Wang Qi said.


Professor Cai Liang from the University’s school of Life Sciences instructed the class and was very pleased the program was made possible. Liang cited its importance stating: “this course puts into practice the theory and methods of active learning and teaching and explores the training mode of undergraduate scientific research and innovation talents.”
